fusions.name: Flicker of Scales
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darting bolts of water at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage. Their damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: School Turns as One
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of water that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Silver
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slips the Grasp
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
